reason: I forget the bottle on my counter all the time, so a sachet I can throw in my bag actually fits how I live. $24.99 is a stretch on my budget, but the money-back guarantee makes it a one-box try.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I'm paying $25 for something that might do nothing, and 'made in China' makes me want to see that lab report before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report wasn't really there for my batch, or the price after launch was well above $30, I'd skip it.
